_comment: MSP-B1 / AT-642 — the MINIMAL read-only IAM policy the native AWS event connector needs, as a partner-security artifact. Every Action here is a call the connector actually makes (no wildcard actions): DescribeAlarmHistory (CloudWatch alarm state changes), ListRules + DescribeRule (bounded EventBridge scoped rules), LookupEvents (CloudTrail management events), and sts:AssumeRole (the hub identity assuming each account's read-only role). Read-only: no create/update/delete, no data-plane reads beyond these operational surfaces. Scope the Resource ARNs to the managed accounts/regions/rules per your environment. See AWS_READONLY_IAM_POLICY.md.

read_only_role_policy._note: Attach to the per-account read-only role the hub assumes (one per managed account).

hub_assume_role_policy._note: Attach to the hub identity. Grants only the ability to assume the per-account read-only roles — scope the Resource to the exact role ARNs you provision.

account_role_trust_policy._note: Trust policy on each per-account read-only role. Allows ONLY the hub identity to assume it, gated by an ExternalId (confused-deputy guard). Replace HUB_ACCOUNT_ID and EXTERNAL_ID.
